## Research use case

Describe the pediatric omics question or reusable workflow need without including patient-level, unpublished, or restricted data.

## Current limitation

Explain what the existing project cannot yet do and why the limitation affects reproducibility or maintainability.

## Proposed change

Describe the intended behaviour, input/output schema, and documentation or test coverage needed.

## Validation plan

State how the change could be tested with synthetic or openly licensed data, including relevant assumptions and limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] This proposal does not request clinical decision-support functionality.
- [ ] Any example data can be synthetic or openly licensed.
- [ ] I have considered whether an existing tool already addresses this need.
